text.en: Pet owners emphasize that their dogs are treated with great affection and kindness throughout their salon visits. Reviewers note that pets receive tasty treats and individualized attention that keeps them relaxed. Clients express full confidence when leaving their four-legged companions in the groomer's hands.

Clients frequently praise Josh for his warm customer service, pleasant conversation, and attentive approach to pet styling. Returning visitors appreciate having a reliable local groomer who remembers their dogs and listens to styling requests. The team creates a friendly neighbourhood atmosphere.

Reviewers are delighted with the quality of the grooming finishes, noting that dogs leave looking impeccably clean and neatly styled. One owner highlights how a scruffy pet was transformed into a stylish companion that received compliments. The thorough styling results meet high aesthetic expectations.

q.en: Where is The Mutz Nutz salon located?

a.en: Reviewers note that the grooming salon is situated in the Notting Hill area of West London.

q.en: Are pet treats and accessories sold in the shop?

a.en: Yes, clients mention picking up popular dog treats and pet supplies during their visits.

q.en: Do the groomers cater to full styling and tidy-ups?

a.en: Yes, customers report excellent full grooms, hygiene trims, and aesthetic transformations for their dogs.

q.en: How do customers describe the grooming rates?

a.en: While noted as higher than some alternative salons, clients consider the styling quality well worth the fee.
